landing.over: UX practice in Arabic and English
landing.headline: Practise real design decisions.
landing.lead: Short lessons where you fix real screens, get feedback that explains why, and prove each skill on a new case.
landing.pQ: Which field can go without hurting Hana's business?
landing.how1b: Each step puts a real screen in front of you and asks what you would change.
landing.how2b: Right or not, you see what your choice does to the people using it.
landing.how3t: Prove it on a new case
landing.how3b: Each unit ends with a skill check on a screen you have not seen.
landing.pathsTitle: Paths that build a real skill
landing.pathsNote: Plus 11 more paths. Unit 1 of every path is free.
landing.q1: Do I need an account to try?
landing.a1: Create a free account and start Unit 1 of any path. A sample lesson without an account is coming.
landing.a2: Every lesson is in Arabic and English. English UX terms stay, with a short Arabic explanation.
